Tone remains positive given strong labor markets and solid activity, but the May 2019 Financial Stability Report flagged elevated corporate leverage and somewhat stretched asset valuations, with market volatility having eased from late-2018 but still a notable risk. Those stability considerations, alongside muted inflation, warrant a more cautious read than a purely macro-based take. Net effect: mildly positive, tempered by identified vulnerabilities.
